notes: Three independent, generalizable report-pipeline deliverables, each re-executed by the verifier on genuinely different hidden inputs: derive.py applies a dispersed numeric clue-rule recipe (add/sub/mul/div/mod, filename-ordered, with malformed skippable step files, negative bases, whitespace and non-step-file noise); diff_series.py averages per-key (not per-row-position) differences between two CSVs with side-aligned keys, duplicate/extra-key and no-common-key edges; report.jq + report_args.json (dash-form options) must re-run byte-for-byte and reproduce exact line ordering on feeds with dropped records, ties, malformed and empty-result cases. All arithmetic/ordering exact. Total 12 -> medium, consistent with the easy floors of all three competencies, driven by cross-deliverable dependent stages, tooling breadth (python + jq), adversarial/malformed input handling and hidden-case generalization.
